decision.explanation: The query 'When did James Scudamore die?' refers to a name shared by multiple distinct historical figures. Source D1/D2 confirms James Scudamore, 3rd Viscount Scudamore died on 2 December 1716. Source D3/D5 confirms James Scudamore (son of the 1st Viscount) died on 18 June 1668. Source D6 confirms Sir James Scudamore (courtier) died in 1619. All three dates correspond to distinct individuals named James Scudamore found in the provided documents and should be retained as valid answers.
